Soulstice is a static, self-guided self-reflection instrument for artists, made by Sinaida Krivchenko. It runs entirely in the visitor's browser as plain HTML, CSS and ES modules, with no build step, no framework and no external requests. It is available in English only. It has no accounts and no analytics, sets no cookies and collects no data: every answer stays in the visitor's own browser storage. Privacy details: https://sinaida-space.github.io/soulstice/#/privacy
